package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

type LessonSourceReference struct {
	ID         string `json:"id"`
	RevisionID string `json:"revision_id,omitempty"`
}
type LessonRequirement struct {
	ID              string                `json:"requirement_id"`
	ActivityID      string                `json:"activity_id"`
	Type            string                `json:"type"`
	Required        bool                  `json:"required"`
	SourceReference LessonSourceReference `json:"source_reference"`
	Satisfied       bool                  `json:"satisfied"`
}
type LessonRevisionActivity struct {
	ID              string                `json:"activity_id"`
	Type            string                `json:"type"`
	Required        bool                  `json:"required"`
	SourceReference LessonSourceReference `json:"source_reference"`
}
type LessonRevision struct {
	Schema     string                   `json:"schema"`
	LessonID   string                   `json:"lesson_id"`
	ID         string                   `json:"lesson_revision_id"`
	Content    json.RawMessage          `json:"content"`
	Activities []LessonRevisionActivity `json:"activities"`
}
type LessonActivityFact struct {
	StudentID, ItemID, RequirementID, Type, SourceID, SourceRevisionID, FactID string
	OccurredAt                                                                 time.Time
}

func ValidateLessonAssignment(item LearningPathItem) error {
	if item.ID != "" && !validJourneyUUID(item.ID) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	if item.LessonRevisionID == "" {
		if len(item.FrozenRequirements) != 0 {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		return nil
	}
	if item.ReferenceType != "lesson" || !validJourneyUUID(item.ID) || !validJourneyUUID(item.LessonRevisionID) || len(item.FrozenRequirements) == 0 || len(item.FrozenRequirements) > 500 {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	required := false
	for _, r := range item.FrozenRequirements {
		if !validJourneyUUID(r.ID) || !validJourneyUUID(r.ActivityID) || seen[r.ID] || !validJourneyUUID(r.SourceReference.ID) {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		seen[r.ID] = true
		switch r.Type {
		case "theory_acknowledged":
		case "quiz_passed", "task_passed", "practice_completed":
			if !validJourneyUUID(r.SourceReference.RevisionID) {
				return ErrValidation
			}
		default:
			return ErrValidation
		}
		required = required || r.Required
	}
	if !required {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

// SatisfyLessonRequirement applies only a matching authoritative successful fact.
// Attempt failures are deliberately absent from this contract.
func SatisfyLessonRequirement(item LearningPathItem, fact LessonActivityFact) (LearningPathItem, bool, error) {
	if err := ValidateLessonAssignment(item); err != nil || item.LessonRevisionID == "" || item.ID != fact.ItemID || !validJourneyUUID(fact.FactID) {
		return item, false, ErrValidation
	}
	if item.Status == LearningPathItemSkippedMastered {
		return item, false, ErrConflict
	}
	item.FrozenRequirements = append([]LessonRequirement(nil), item.FrozenRequirements...)
	found := false
	changed := false
	for i, r := range item.FrozenRequirements {
		if r.ID != fact.RequirementID {
			continue
		}
		found = true
		if r.Type != fact.Type || r.SourceReference.ID != fact.SourceID || r.SourceReference.RevisionID != fact.SourceRevisionID {
			return item, false, ErrConflict
		}
		if !r.Satisfied {
			item.FrozenRequirements[i].Satisfied = true
			changed = true
		}
	}
	if !found {
		return item, false, ErrNotFound
	}
	if !changed {
		return item, false, nil
	}
	complete := true
	for _, r := range item.FrozenRequirements {
		if r.Required && !r.Satisfied {
			complete = false
		}
	}
	if complete {
		item.Status = LearningPathItemCompleted
		item.ReasonCode = "lesson_requirements_satisfied"
	} else {
		item.Status = LearningPathItemInProgress
		item.ReasonCode = "lesson_activity_satisfied"
	}
	return item, true, nil
}

func PublicLessonContent(raw json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error) {
	var content map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &content); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid frozen content: %w", err)
	}
	output := map[string]json.RawMessage{}
	for _, key := range []string{"title", "excerpt", "description", "translations"} {
		if v, ok := content[key]; ok {
			output[key] = v
		}
	}
	var tasks []map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(content["tasks"], &tasks); err != nil && len(content["tasks"]) != 0 {
		return nil, err
	}
	publicTasks := []any{}
	for _, task := range tasks {
		t := map[string]json.RawMessage{}
		for _, key := range []string{"id", "lesson_id", "title", "description", "type", "task_kind", "execution_mode", "evaluation_mode", "ui_mode", "submission_mode", "order", "status", "max_attempts", "requires_sandbox", "exposes_preview", "exposes_terminal", "supports_live_validation"} {
			if v, ok := task[key]; ok {
				t[key] = v
			}
		}
		var tests []map[string]json.RawMessage
		_ = json.Unmarshal(task["tests"], &tests)
		publicTests := []any{}
		for _, test := range tests {
			q := map[string]json.RawMessage{}
			for _, key := range []string{"id", "kind", "title", "description", "order"} {
				if v, ok := test[key]; ok {
					q[key] = v
				}
			}
			for _, key := range []string{"variants", "groups"} {
				var rows []map[string]json.RawMessage
				_ = json.Unmarshal(test[key], &rows)
				clean := []any{}
				for _, row := range rows {
					r := map[string]json.RawMessage{}
					for _, field := range []string{"id", "title", "text", "order"} {
						if v, ok := row[field]; ok {
							r[field] = v
						}
					}
					clean = append(clean, r)
				}
				q[key], _ = json.Marshal(clean)
			}
			publicTests = append(publicTests, q)
		}
		var structure any
		if json.Unmarshal(task["code_structure"], &structure) == nil {
			var scrub func(any)
			scrub = func(value any) {
				switch x := value.(type) {
				case map[string]any:
					for k, v := range x {
						switch k {
						case "expected_answers", "reference_solution", "private_suite_ref", "private_test_suite", "negative_fixtures", "verifier_artifacts", "answer_key":
							delete(x, k)
						default:
							scrub(v)
						}
					}
				case []any:
					for _, v := range x {
						scrub(v)
					}
				}
			}
			scrub(structure)
			t["code_structure"], _ = json.Marshal(structure)
		}
		if v, ok := task["code_structure_type_code"]; ok {
			t["code_structure_type_code"] = v
		}
		t["tests"], _ = json.Marshal(publicTests)
		publicTasks = append(publicTasks, t)
	}
	output["tasks"], _ = json.Marshal(publicTasks)
	return json.Marshal(output)
}
